source.kind: append-only validated public depth-20 book journal

replay.splitRule: first 70% of global captured book-time range for development, final 30% held out

methodology.entry: first subsequent executable YES ask after decision latency
methodology.exit: first executable YES bid at or after entry plus fixed hold

strategyDefinitions.trend: enter YES only when trailing mid-price change is positive
strategyDefinitions.reversion: enter YES only when trailing mid-price change is negative
strategyDefinitions.unconditional: enter YES at every eligible decision

topOfBookQuantity.unit: shares at best price; replay trades one share only

decision: paper research only; no API, account, collector, live worker, or contest-order operation
